meta.regen_note: This ssi-data.json is reproducible from active scripts (score-country.py + country-config + OSM) — the regen recipe is in scripts/build_<country>_ssi.py or by direct score-country.py invocation. Future cron preserves these values unless an explicit regen is invoked.

phase_d_remaining_runs.convention: #56-honest — real per-country agency data, SHA-1 jitter
